title: Article 106 Article 106  (1) A subagent represents the principal with respect to acts within the scope of the authority thereof.
statute_text:
Article 106 Article 106  (1) A subagent represents the principal with respect to acts within the scope of the authority thereof.
(2) A subagent has the same rights and obligations as an agent in relation to the principal and third parties within the scope of that subagent's authority.
(Abuse of Authority to Represent)
